Definition: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4095; a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate:--cup.
BiblicalUsage: Poterion is the cup, the drinking vessel and what it holds, and Scripture fills it two ways. Jesus asks the sons of Zebedee if they can drink of the cup he will drink of, and in Gethsemane he prays for the cup to pass. Paul calls it the cup of blessing we bless and the cup of the new testament in his blood.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cup holds both suffering and blessing at once, and Christ drank the bitter part so we could drink the blessed one. Every time I take the cup I remember that exchange.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
